$comment: Strings the string lint (pnpm ui:lint) accepts that are not catalog messages: the mockup fixtures (UI-KITS.md §8: Tidewater Studio by Harbor Audio, Drift Kart by Lanternworks, Fennick Studio's devices and people), the product's own content the kit only displays (release notes, store prices), glyphs, and values a kit formats rather than translates (keys, codes, versions). Every entry needs a reason. Copy belongs in packages/brand/kit-copy/en.json, never here; a board string that should be copy and is not in the catalog is recorded in strings.debt.json instead.

allow.reason: Glyphs only: separators, status marks, progress bars and spinner frames carry no copy.
Controller and keyboard glyphs (A, B, X, L1, R1): the kits draw them as icon textures.
Fixture product names with tier and version (ProductIdentity values, §4.7).
Fixture tier and term names (license data, not copy).
Fixture developer, organisation and person names.

allow.pattern: Work laptop|Mara’s iPad|Mara’s studio iPad|MacBook Pro|Studio Mac mini|Living room PC|build-server-02
allow.reason: Fixture device names (device records, not copy).
License keys, key fragments and sign-in codes are values the kit formats (§1.5 rule 12).
Store prices, percentages, counts, versions and the status-bar time: formatted values.
Device-code and release-notes URLs (theme value product.deviceCodeUrl, release data).

allow.pattern: Stem export in one (click|tap), with loudness matching|Stem export in one tap, and fixes|Track freeze (now )?works with every plug-in|Fixes a crash when unplugging an (audio )?interface|Night Circuit: four new tracks after dark|Split-screen for up to four players
allow.reason: Fixture release notes: the product's own release content, shown by the kit, not translated by it.
Fixture session tracks in the host app around the kit.
The command line the person typed, echoed above the program's output (the bin name is the fixture product's).
The terminal window's title bar: the fixture product and the command running.
A device id the kit prints for the person to copy (a value, not copy).
